communicate.description: Send a short coordination message to the other agent in the scene. args.to must be that agent's exact ID. Set args.releases to the exact symbolic id of a thing you have finished with and are handing over -- that, and only that, wakes a partner who is waiting on it. Omit args.releases from every other message. args.releases must be an object id or a fixture id that appears in initial_state, copied exactly. It names a THING, never an event or a status: 'coffee_machine' and 'mug' are ids; 'mug_placed', 'counter_free' and 'task_done' are not, and an id that does not exist releases nothing at all. coordination_phase is optional and must be omitted from ordinary messages. Use it only for the opening propose/await_plan/await_confirmation/confirm handshake or for portion_complete.

wait_for_signal.description: Pause until the other agent hands over what you are waiting for. args.about names that thing by its exact symbolic id -- an object id or a fixture id that appears in initial_state, copied exactly. It is a THING you are waiting FOR, never an event you are waiting ON: wait about='coffee_machine', never about='mug_placed' or 'your_turn'. An id that is not in initial_state can never be released, so the wait blocks forever and the whole plan is thrown away. You stay paused until args.from sends a communicate whose args.releases names the same id -- their other messages do not wake you, so you do not need to wait again after an unrelated one.

navigate_to_fixture.description: Move the robot base to the working pose of a fixture.

open_hinged_part.description: Open a hinged door, lid, or articulated head on a fixture.

close_hinged_part.description: Close a hinged door, lid, or articulated head on a fixture.

pick_up_object.description: Grasp and lift an object from a symbolic source region.

place_on_object.description: Place an object on top of another movable support object such as a plate or cutting_board.

give_space.description: Yield working room at a fixture so the other agent can complete an action there.

task_goal: Retrieve the sausage and cheese from the fridge and place them on the cutting board on the counter.
extra_execution_rules: Open the fridge door before picking up ingredients.
Place both ingredients on the cutting board where the baguette is located.
After picking up sausage or cheese from the fridge, navigate directly to the counter and place it on the cutting board before manipulating the fridge again.
Do not use close_hinged_part while holding sausage or cheese.
Only use give_space at a fixture where that agent is already positioned.
As soon as both sausage and cheese are on the cutting board, end the trajectory immediately without any cleanup or extra actions.

task_preconditions.message: The fridge must be open to retrieve ingredients.

args.message: I will get the sausage first. Please clear the fridge, then return for the cheese after I place the sausage.

steps.reasoning: Coordinating a sequential handoff at the shared fridge and counter.

args.message: Understood. I will give space at the fridge now and return for the cheese once the sausage is on the cutting board.

steps.reasoning: Acknowledging the sequence so only one agent works at the fridge at a time.
Clearing a shared fixture already occupied by this agent before the other agent uses it.
Opening the fridge to access the ingredients.
Carrying the sausage directly to the counter for placement.
Placing the sausage on the cutting board.

args.message: Sausage is on the cutting board. The fridge is still open, so you can get the cheese now.

steps.reasoning: Letting agent_1 know the shared counter is nearly free and the fridge remains accessible.
Clearing the counter so agent_1 can place the cheese.
Returning to the fridge after previously giving space there.
Picking up the cheese while the fridge is still open.
Carrying the cheese directly to the counter for placement.
Placing the cheese on the cutting board.
